row: Medical rehabilitation is a necessity for many patients dealing with serious injury or illness in order to make a maximized recovery. San Joaquin Valley Rehabilitation Hospital offers long-term inpatient and outpatient physical therapy services that traditional medical centers do not have the time or resources to provide their patients. Whether you are staying with us overnight for the foreseeable future or coming in daily for your therapy session, our team will provide you with focused, personalized care that addresses your specific medical needs and goals.
